tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search structured products using exact SKU or GTIN, supplier, material, dimensions, MOQ, price, inventory, lead time and qualification filters. Defaults to sandbox; use environment=production for approved supplier storefront listings.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Find approved public supplier storefronts and inspect reviewed credentials and platform-observed performance.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Retrieve a public supplier storefront by stable supplier ID or public slug.

tools.name: list_supplier_products
tools.description: List precisely filtered, approved catalog products for a public supplier storefront.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve a product as Schema.org JSON-LD from the selected catalog environment.

tools.name: compare_quotes
tools.description: Compare quotes by quantity and destination. Returns quote options without creating an order. Quote and order settlement remain simulated in this environment.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a retrievable quote snapshot for selected SKUs, quantities and destination. Check freshness, MOQ and supplier confirmation first; settlement remains simulated.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Retrieve a previously created quote by quoteId and inspect its expiry, line items, destination and supplier options.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a B2B order from a confirmed quote. The order is routed to the supplier identified by its SKU; production orders notify that supplier, while sandbox orders are marked test-only and never trigger shipping.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read order status, tracking number, ETA, payment mode and fulfillment events.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.description: Advance a sandbox order through an allowed fulfillment state transition and emit its webhook event. Use only when the responsible fulfillment party has supplied evidence.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order before fulfillment when the state machine permits it. Cancellation is terminal and emits order.cancelled.

tools.name: compare_supplier_offers
tools.description: Compare eligible supplier offers for the same requested SKUs, quantity and destination. This is read-only and returns estimated shipping separately from item subtotal.

tools.name: get_supplier_performance
tools.description: Retrieve platform-observed supplier fulfillment metrics, order sample size and as-of timestamp. Self-reported claims are not substituted for observed data.

tools.name: search_shipping_rates
tools.description: Estimate shipping options from a supplier origin to a destination using weight, dimensions and quantity. Results are sandbox estimates and require carrier confirmation before checkout.

tools.name: lookup_tariffs
tools.description: Return a preliminary HS-code and destination tariff estimate. Customs classification and the final duty remain subject to broker confirmation.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Combine product subtotal, estimated shipping and preliminary duty into a destination landed-cost range. The response includes assumptions and must not be treated as a binding quote.

tools.name: request_buyer_confirmation
tools.description: Create a short-lived explicit confirmation request for a quote before any order mutation. This tool has no payment or order side effect.

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Send a support request from an agent to the BuyingMesh operator by email. Never include private keys, passwords or payment secrets.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: q, sku, gtin, category, supplierId, supplierSlug, material, size, minMoq, maxMoq, minPrice, maxPrice, currency, minInventory, inventoryStatus, maxLeadTimeDays, qualificationStatus, verifiedOnly, cursor, limit, environment

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_suppliers" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
